blocks.zh: 廠房設施與公用系統
blocks.en: Facilities and Utilities

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解廠房設計 (Facility Design) 如何作為污染控制策略 (CCS) 的結構性屏障基礎
blocks.en: Understand how facility design serves as the structural barrier foundation of the contamination control strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: 掌握人員流、物料流與廢棄物流的設計原則及其對污染控制的影響
blocks.en: Master the design principles for personnel, material and waste flows and their impact on contamination control

blocks.zh: 認識關鍵公用系統（水、蒸汽、HVAC、氣體）在 CCS 中的角色與監控要點
blocks.en: Recognize the role of critical utilities (water, steam, HVAC, gases) in the CCS and the key points to monitor

blocks.zh: 學會區分「整體性思維 (Holistic Approach)」與「片段式思維 (Non-Holistic Approach)」在設施與公用系統管理上的差異
blocks.en: Distinguish between a "holistic approach" and a "non-holistic approach" in managing facilities and utilities

blocks.zh: 了解物料轉移的三大污染控制策略：化學消毒、分層包裝去除、滅菌系統直接傳遞
blocks.en: Understand the three contamination control strategies for material transfer: chemical disinfection, shedding of packaging layers, and direct transfer through a sterilization system

blocks.en: 5.0 Facilities and Utilities

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Facilities and Utilities (廠房設施與公用系統)：本章涵蓋藥品製造環境的「硬體骨架」——從廠房建築設計到水、蒸汽、空調、氣體等公用系統。這些是 CCS 的物理基礎層，所有後續的製程控制、人員管控、環境監測都建立在這個基礎之上。
blocks.en: Facilities and Utilities: This section covers the "hardware backbone" of the pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, from the building design to utilities such as water, steam, air conditioning and gases. These form the physical foundation layer of the CCS; all downstream process controls, personnel controls and environmental monitoring are built on top of it.

blocks.zh: TR90 將本章定位為 CCS 的「結構性屏障 (structure-based barriers)」——意味著好的設施設計本身就能大幅降低污染風險，而不需要過度依賴人為操作或程序性控制。
blocks.en: TR90 positions this section as the CCS's "structure-based barriers", meaning that good facility design can substantially reduce contamination risk in itself, without relying excessively on human operation or procedural controls.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 把廠房設施想像成一座醫院的建築設計：手術室的正壓通風、獨立的潔淨走廊、與污染區的物理隔離——這些「建築本身的設計」就是第一道防線。如果醫院建築設計有缺陷（例如手術室門開向走廊沒有氣閘），再嚴格的消毒程序也很難完全補救。藥廠設施設計的邏輯完全相同。
blocks.en: Think of a facility as the architectural design of a hospital: positive-pressure ventilation in the operating room, separate clean corridors and physical segregation from contaminated areas are the first line of defense, and they are built into the building itself. If the building design is flawed (for example, an operating room door that opens straight onto a corridor with no airlock), even the strictest disinfection procedures can hardly make up for it. The logic for pharmaceutical facility design is exactly the same.

blocks.zh: 5.1 Facility Design 5.1 廠房設計
blocks.en: 5.1 Facility Design

blocks.zh: Structure-based Barriers (結構性屏障)：指透過廠房設計本身建立的污染防禦體系，包括氣壓梯度 (air pressure cascades)、區域分級 (area classifications)、物理隔離 (physical segregation) 等。這些是「被動式」防禦——不需要人為操作即可持續運作。
blocks.en: Structure-based Barriers: A contamination defense system established by the facility design itself, including air pressure cascades, area classifications and physical segregation. These are "passive" defenses that keep working without any human operation.

blocks.zh: Good Engineering Practices, GEPs (良好工程實務)：在設計階段就依據工程原理和產業最佳實務來規劃廠房，而非等到建成後再「補救」。
blocks.en: Good Engineering Practices (GEPs): Planning the facility from the design stage on the basis of engineering principles and industry best practices, rather than waiting until after construction to "fix" problems.

blocks.zh: Closed or Functionally Closed Processes (封閉或功能性封閉製程)：TR90 明確指出這是「最有效的污染控制措施」。封閉系統將產品與環境完全隔離，大幅降低對環境潔淨度的依賴。
blocks.en: Closed or Functionally Closed Processes: TR90 explicitly identifies these as the "most effective contamination control measure". A closed system isolates the product completely from the environment and greatly reduces reliance on environmental cleanliness.

blocks.zh: Adventitious Agent (外來因子)：非預期引入的生物污染物，如病毒。當同一廠房生產多種病毒產品時，交叉污染風險極高，需要獨立的 HVAC、專用走廊、BSL 等級隔離。
blocks.en: Adventitious Agent: A biological contaminant, such as a virus, that is introduced unintentionally. When several viral products are made in the same facility, the cross-contamination risk is very high, and separate HVAC, dedicated corridors and BSL-level segregation are needed.

blocks.zh: 想像你在設計一棟傳染病醫院：你不會把一般門診和結核病房放在同一層共用同一套空調系統，對吧？製藥廠的設計邏輯完全相同——特別是當你在同一廠房生產多種病毒產品時，每一條「空氣的路徑」、每一個「人員的動線」、每一件「設備的專屬性」都必須在藍圖階段就規劃清楚。事後改建不僅昂貴，而且往往無法達到與原始設計同等的控制效果。
blocks.en: Imagine designing an infectious disease hospital: you would not put the general outpatient clinic and the tuberculosis ward on the same floor sharing one air-conditioning system. The design logic for a pharmaceutical plant is exactly the same, especially when you make several viral products in one facility. Every "air path", every "personnel route" and every "piece of dedicated equipment" must be planned at the blueprint stage. Retrofitting later is not only expensive but often fails to achieve the same level of control as the original design.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: Holistic vs. Non-Holistic 的關鍵差異：
blocks.en: The key difference between Holistic and Non-Holistic:

blocks.zh: 非整體性思維：「環境監測結果沒超標，所以設計缺陷不需要額外控制。」——這是危險的被動態度。
blocks.en: Non-holistic thinking: "Environmental monitoring results did not exceed limits, so the design flaw needs no additional control." This is a dangerous, reactive attitude.

blocks.zh: 整體性思維：環境監測只是偵測手段之一，重點應放在工程控制的穩健性、關鍵參數趨勢分析、甚至低於警戒值的趨勢變化。
blocks.en: Holistic thinking: Environmental monitoring is only one detection tool. The emphasis should be on the robustness of engineering controls, trend analysis of critical parameters, and even trend changes below the alert level.

blocks.zh: TR90 特別強調「recovery rates（回收率）」比「是否超過 action level」更重要——這是一個思維轉變：我們不應只關注「有沒有超標」，而要關注「系統恢復正常狀態的能力有多強」。
blocks.en: TR90 particularly stresses that "recovery rates" matter more than "whether an action level is exceeded". This is a change of mindset: we should not only ask "was a limit exceeded?" but also "how strong is the system's ability to return to its normal state?"

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：當你承接一個新的病毒載體 (viral vector) 產品合約時，需要評估現有設施是否能安全容納該產品。關鍵問題包括：
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: When you take on a contract for a new viral vector product, you need to assess whether the existing facility can safely accommodate it. Key questions include:

blocks.zh: 現有 HVAC 是否能獨立運作或需要專用系統？
blocks.en: Can the existing HVAC operate independently, or is a dedicated system needed?

blocks.zh: 人員動線是否能確保不同產品的操作人員不交叉？
blocks.en: Do personnel routes ensure that operators of different products do not cross paths?

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒程序是否足以清除病毒殘留？
blocks.en: Are the cleaning and disinfection procedures sufficient to remove viral residues?

blocks.zh: 是否需要專用的 QC 實驗室以避免分析交叉污染？
blocks.en: Is a dedicated QC laboratory needed to avoid analytical cross-contamination?

blocks.zh: 這些都需要在簽約前以 QRM 工具進行正式風險評估，而非憑經驗判斷。
blocks.en: All of these should be formally risk assessed with QRM tools before the contract is signed, rather than judged from experience alone.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 認為「封閉或功能性封閉製程」是最有效的污染控制措施？這對單次使用 (single-use) 系統的採用有何推動作用？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 consider "closed or functionally closed processes" the most effective contamination control measure? How does this encourage the adoption of single-use systems?

blocks.zh: 請解釋 Table 5.1-1 中「focus on recovery rates rather than exceeding action levels」的含義。在你的工廠中，如何實踐這個原則？
blocks.en: Explain what "focus on recovery rates rather than exceeding action levels" in Table 5.1-1 means. How do you put this principle into practice in your facility?

blocks.zh: 如果你的工廠已經在運作中發現 HVAC 設計不當（例如壓差不穩定），在無法立即改建的情況下，你會採取哪些臨時性控制措施？
blocks.en: If your operating facility is found to have an inadequate HVAC design (for example, unstable differential pressure) and it cannot be rebuilt immediately, what interim controls would you put in place?

blocks.zh: 5.2 Personnel Flow 5.2 人員流向
blocks.en: 5.2 Personnel Flow

blocks.zh: Personnel Flow (人員流動)：人員在廠房內的移動路線設計。TR90 開宗明義指出：「人是潔淨室中微生物的主要來源 (primary source)」——這是所有無菌製造的基本認知。
blocks.en: Personnel Flow: The design of the routes people take through the facility. TR90 opens by stating that "people are the primary source of microorganisms in the cleanroom", which is the basic premise of all sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: Unidirectional Movement (單向流動)：人員只能沿著從潔淨區到非潔淨區的單一方向移動，不能回頭。這避免了已接觸低潔淨區的人員將污染帶回高潔淨區。
blocks.en: Unidirectional Movement: Personnel move in a single direction only, from the cleaner area to the less clean area, and do not turn back. This prevents people who have been in a lower-cleanliness area from carrying contamination back into a higher-cleanliness area.

blocks.zh: Comingling (混流)：不同更衣等級的人員混在一起。例如，穿全套無菌衣的 B 級人員和只穿廠服的 D 級人員在同一走廊交會——這是嚴重的污染風險。
blocks.en: Comingling: Personnel in different gowning levels mixing together. For example, a Grade B operator in full sterile gowning and a Grade D operator in plant uniform passing each other in the same corridor is a serious contamination risk.

blocks.zh: 想像一座機場航廈：通過安檢後的旅客（潔淨區人員）和尚未安檢的旅客（非潔淨區人員）被嚴格隔離。一旦你通過安檢進入管制區，就不能隨意回到非管制區再走回來——因為這會破壞整個安檢的意義。藥廠的人員單向流動也是同樣的道理。
blocks.en: Think of an airport terminal: passengers who have passed security (cleanroom personnel) and those who have not (personnel from unclassified areas) are strictly separated. Once you have cleared security and entered the controlled area, you cannot freely walk back out and return, because that would defeat the purpose of the whole screening. Unidirectional personnel flow in a pharmaceutical plant follows the same logic.

blocks.zh: 既有設施的挑戰：TR90 務實地承認，並非所有工廠都能實現完美的單向流。對於既有設施，需要額外的「程序控制」和「設計補救」來防止混流——例如時間管理（不同班次分時進出）、視覺標示系統、電子門禁控制等。
blocks.en: The challenge for existing facilities: TR90 pragmatically acknowledges that not every plant can achieve perfect unidirectional flow. For existing facilities, additional "procedural controls" and "design remediation" are needed to prevent comingling, for example time management (staggered entry and exit by shift), visual signage systems and electronic access control.

blocks.zh: 值得注意的是，TR90 將更衣和行為規範的細節留到 Section 8.0 討論，這裡強調的是「動線設計」——物理空間層面的控制。
blocks.en: It is worth noting that TR90 leaves the details of gowning and behavioral rules to Section 8.0. What is emphasized here is "route design", that is, control at the level of physical space.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「人是潔淨室中微生物的主要來源」？人體大約每分鐘會釋放多少微粒？這對 Grade A/B 環境有何影響？
blocks.en: Why are "people the primary source of microorganisms in the cleanroom"? Roughly how many particles does the human body release per minute? What does this mean for Grade A/B environments?

blocks.zh: 在你的廠房中，如果無法實現完美的單向人員流動，你會設計哪些替代控制措施？
blocks.en: In your facility, if perfect unidirectional personnel flow cannot be achieved, what alternative controls would you design?

blocks.zh: 5.3 Material and Waste Controls 5.3 物料與廢棄物管制
blocks.en: 5.3 Material and Waste Controls

blocks.zh: Material Transfer (物料轉移)：將物料從非潔淨區安全引入潔淨製造區的程序。這是一個高風險環節，因為外部包裝（紙箱、塑膠膜）攜帶大量微生物，尤其是黴菌和細菌孢子。
blocks.en: Material Transfer: The procedure for safely bringing materials from an unclassified area into the clean manufacturing area. This is a high-risk step because outer packaging (cartons, plastic film) carries large numbers of microorganisms, especially molds and bacterial spores.

blocks.zh: 三大物料轉移控制策略：
blocks.en: Three material transfer control strategies:

blocks.zh: 化學消毒 (Chemical Disinfection)：使用經確效的消毒劑擦拭物料表面，必須包括物理擦拭（機械去除）和最低接觸時間。
blocks.en: Chemical Disinfection: Wiping the material surface with a validated disinfectant, which must include physical wiping (mechanical removal) and a minimum contact time.

blocks.zh: 分層包裝去除 (Shedding Layers)：物料以多層無菌包裝準備，每進入更高潔淨等級區域時去除一層——類似機場安檢的多重關卡。
blocks.en: Shedding Layers: Materials are prepared in multiple layers of sterile packaging, and one layer is removed on entry to each higher cleanliness area, much like the multiple checkpoints at an airport.

blocks.zh: 滅菌系統直接傳遞 (Direct Sterilization Transfer)：透過 pass-through autoclave、電子束系統或 Rapid Transfer Port (RTP，快速傳遞口) 直接傳入。
blocks.en: Direct Sterilization Transfer: Direct transfer through a pass-through autoclave, an electron beam system or a Rapid Transfer Port (RTP).

blocks.zh: Spill Response (洩漏應變)：當物料或廢棄物在潔淨區發生洩漏時的緊急處理程序，這常被忽略但極為重要。
blocks.en: Spill Response: The emergency procedure for when materials or waste spill in a cleanroom. It is often overlooked but extremely important.

blocks.zh: 想像你要把外面市場買來的食材帶進手術室等級的廚房：你不可能直接把帶著泥巴的蔬菜、沾著血水的塑膠袋拿進去。你需要在廚房外面先去除外包裝（分層去除），再用消毒液擦拭（化學消毒），或者直接把食材通過紫外線消毒箱（滅菌傳遞系統）送入。每一層「關卡」都在降低污染物跟著食材一起進入的風險。
blocks.en: Imagine bringing ingredients bought at an outside market into an operating-room-grade kitchen: you would never carry in muddy vegetables or blood-stained plastic bags directly. You would first remove the outer packaging outside the kitchen (shedding layers), then wipe with disinfectant (chemical disinfection), or pass the ingredients through a UV disinfection box (sterilizing transfer system). Each "checkpoint" lowers the risk of contaminants entering along with the ingredients.

blocks.zh: 容易被忽略的細節：
blocks.en: Easily overlooked details:

blocks.zh: 外包裝的靜電效應 (electrostatic charge) 會吸附微生物——這不是直覺上會想到的污染機制，但 TR90 特別提出。
blocks.en: The electrostatic charge on outer packaging attracts microorganisms. This is not an intuitive contamination mechanism, but TR90 specifically raises it.

blocks.zh: 化學消毒不只是「噴一噴」——必須有物理擦拭動作（mechanical removal）加上經確效的最低接觸時間。
blocks.en: Chemical disinfection is more than "just spraying": it requires physical wiping (mechanical removal) plus a validated minimum contact time.

blocks.zh: 廢棄物的流動方向也很重要：廢棄物「出去」的過程同樣可能造成污染擴散，不能只關注物料「進來」。
blocks.en: The direction of waste flow also matters: waste moving "out" can equally spread contamination, so attention must not be limited to materials coming "in".

blocks.zh: CDMO 在同時處理多個客戶產品時，物料和廢棄物的專用路徑設計尤為重要。考量以下情境：
blocks.en: For a CDMO handling several clients' products at once, designing dedicated routes for materials and waste is especially important. Consider the following scenarios:

blocks.zh: Product A 使用的培養基從倉庫到配製區的路線，是否與 Product B 的廢棄物出口路線交叉？
blocks.en: Does the route taking Product A's culture medium from the warehouse to the preparation area cross Product B's waste exit route?

blocks.zh: 是否需要為不同客戶的原料設置獨立的物料氣閘 (material airlock)？
blocks.en: Are separate material airlocks needed for different clients' raw materials?

blocks.zh: Rapid Transfer Port (RTP) 在隔離器操作中是否已被驗證為無菌傳遞手段？
blocks.en: Has the Rapid Transfer Port (RTP) been validated as a sterile transfer method in isolator operations?

blocks.zh: 為什麼紙箱和塑膠包裝是潔淨區的主要污染威脅？除了微生物，還有哪些類型的污染物會隨外包裝進入？
blocks.en: Why are cartons and plastic packaging a major contamination threat to cleanrooms? Besides microorganisms, what other types of contaminants enter with outer packaging?

blocks.zh: 你的工廠如何確保化學消毒的「最低接觸時間」被一致遵守？有哪些常見的偏差情形？
blocks.en: How does your facility ensure that the "minimum contact time" for chemical disinfection is followed consistently? What are the common deviations?

blocks.zh: 設計一個從倉庫到 Grade B 區域的物料轉移流程，列出每個步驟的污染控制措施。
blocks.en: Design a material transfer process from the warehouse to a Grade B area, listing the contamination control measures at each step.

blocks.zh: 5.4 Cleaning and Disinfection for Facilities 5.4 廠房清潔與消毒
blocks.en: 5.4 Cleaning and Disinfection for Facilities

blocks.zh: Cleaning and Disinfection Program (清潔與消毒計畫)：TR90 在此處僅簡短提及，並將讀者導向 PDA TR70 以獲取完整指南。這表示清潔消毒是一個獨立且龐大的專題，值得專門研讀。
blocks.en: Cleaning and Disinfection Program: TR90 mentions this only briefly here and refers readers to PDA TR70 for full guidance. This indicates that cleaning and disinfection is a separate and substantial subject that deserves dedicated study.

blocks.zh: 清潔 (Cleaning) 和消毒 (Disinfection) 是兩個不同的步驟：清潔是去除可見和不可見的殘留物（包括有機物和無機物），消毒則是殺滅或減少殘存微生物。順序很重要——必須先清潔再消毒，因為有機物殘留會降低消毒劑的效力。
blocks.en: Cleaning and disinfection are two different steps: cleaning removes visible and invisible residues (organic and inorganic), while disinfection kills or reduces the remaining microorganisms. The order matters: clean first, then disinfect, because organic residues reduce the efficacy of the disinfectant.

blocks.zh: 這就像你在家洗碗：你不會直接把髒盤子泡在消毒水裡——你得先用洗碗精把油污和食物殘渣清掉（清潔），然後才能用消毒水或高溫殺菌（消毒）。如果碗盤上還殘留一層油膜，消毒水根本接觸不到細菌，效果大打折扣。
blocks.en: It is like washing dishes at home: you would not drop dirty plates straight into disinfectant. You first remove grease and food residue with dish soap (cleaning), and only then use disinfectant or heat to kill germs (disinfection). If a film of grease remains on the dish, the disinfectant cannot reach the bacteria and its effect is greatly reduced.

blocks.zh: 雖然 TR90 本節內容簡短，但清潔消毒計畫在 CCS 中的重要性不可低估。一個完整的計畫應包含：
blocks.en: Although this section of TR90 is short, the importance of the cleaning and disinfection program in the CCS should not be underestimated. A complete program should include:

blocks.zh: 消毒劑的選擇與輪替策略（防止微生物抗藥性）
blocks.en: Disinfectant selection and rotation strategy (to prevent microbial resistance)

blocks.zh: 消毒劑效力確效（Efficacy Validation）
blocks.en: Disinfectant efficacy validation

blocks.zh: 清潔/消毒頻率與時程
blocks.en: Cleaning and disinfection frequency and schedule

blocks.zh: 殘留物管控（避免消毒劑殘留影響產品）
blocks.en: Residue control (to prevent disinfectant residues from affecting the product)

blocks.zh: 人員培訓與操作一致性確認
blocks.en: Personnel training and verification of consistent execution

blocks.zh: 建議搭配閱讀 PDA TR70 以建立完整知識。
blocks.en: It is recommended to read PDA TR70 alongside to build a complete body of knowledge.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 選擇不在本章深入討論清潔消毒，而是引用 TR70？這反映了 CCS 的什麼特性？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 choose not to discuss cleaning and disinfection in depth in this section, and instead cite TR70? What does this reflect about the nature of the CCS?

blocks.zh: 消毒劑輪替 (rotation) 的目的是什麼？常見的輪替策略是怎樣的？
blocks.en: What is the purpose of disinfectant rotation? What are common rotation strategies?

blocks.zh: 5.5 Utility Design, Control, and Validation 5.5 公用系統設計、管制與驗證
blocks.en: 5.5 Utility Design, Control, and Validation

blocks.zh: Critical Utility Systems (關鍵公用系統)：直接與產品流接觸的系統——水 (Water)、蒸汽 (Steam)、HVAC、氣體 (Gases)。它們是製程的「血液」，正常運轉時你甚至感覺不到它們的存在，但一旦出問題，後果嚴重到可能導致停產或產品污染。
blocks.en: Critical Utility Systems: Systems that come into direct contact with the product stream: water, steam, HVAC and gases. They are the "lifeblood" of the process. You hardly notice them when they run normally, but when they fail, the consequences can be severe enough to cause production shutdown or product contamination.

blocks.zh: Noncritical Support Utilities (非關鍵支援系統)：冷卻水、真空系統、預處理進水等。雖然不直接接觸產品，但可能間接影響關鍵系統——例如冷卻水洩漏可能污染製程環境。
blocks.en: Noncritical Support Utilities: Cooling water, vacuum systems, pretreatment feed water and the like. Although they do not contact the product directly, they can affect critical systems indirectly; for example, a cooling water leak can contaminate the process environment.

blocks.zh: Adulteration (摻雜/污染)：產品因公用系統問題而被不當物質污染，這是最嚴重的 GMP 違規之一。
blocks.en: Adulteration: The product is contaminated by unwanted substances because of a utility problem. This is one of the most serious GMP violations.

blocks.zh: 公用系統就像一棟大樓的水電管線：當水管正常運作時，你打開水龍頭就有乾淨的水，根本不會去想管線的事。但如果水管銹蝕、接縫漏水、或水塔被污染——整棟大樓都會受影響。最可怕的是，很多管線問題是「慢慢惡化」的——你可能在出事前很久就有微妙的警示訊號（水壓下降、水質微變），但如果你只看「有沒有超標」，你就會錯過這些早期警訊。
blocks.en: Utilities are like the plumbing and wiring of a building: when the pipes work normally, you open the tap and get clean water without thinking about the pipework. But if the pipes corrode, joints leak or the water tower is contaminated, the whole building is affected. The scariest part is that many piping problems "deteriorate slowly". There may be subtle warning signs long before anything goes wrong (falling water pressure, slight changes in water quality), but if you only look at "whether a limit was exceeded", you will miss these early warnings.

blocks.zh: Table 5.1.4-1🔍 的三個關鍵思維轉變：
blocks.en: Three key mindset shifts in Table 5.1.4-1🔍:

blocks.zh: 「獨立設備」→「CCS 的核心組成」：公用系統不是獨立運作的機器，而是整個污染控制策略的關鍵環節。
blocks.en: From "standalone equipment" to "core component of the CCS": Utilities are not machines that operate in isolation but a key link in the entire contamination control strategy.

blocks.zh: 「測試結果合格 = 沒問題」→「物理參數趨勢才是早期預警」：微生物測試有固有限制（取樣量小、培養時間長），物理參數（溫度、壓力、流速、TOC）能即時反映系統狀態。
blocks.en: From "passing test results = no problem" to "physical parameter trends are the early warning": Microbial testing has inherent limitations (small sample volume, long incubation time), whereas physical parameters (temperature, pressure, flow rate, TOC) reflect the system state in real time.

blocks.zh: 「只有超標才查」→「任何異常趨勢都值得關注」：包括 sub-alert level results（低於警戒值的結果），因為它們可能是系統惡化的早期訊號。
blocks.en: From "investigate only when limits are exceeded" to "any abnormal trend deserves attention": This includes sub-alert level results, because they may be an early sign of system deterioration.

blocks.zh: TR90 為何特別強調「非關鍵支援系統」也需要控制？請舉出一個非關鍵系統失控導致產品風險的實際案例。
blocks.en: Why does TR90 particularly emphasize that "noncritical support systems" also need control? Give a real example in which loss of control of a noncritical system led to product risk.

blocks.zh: 「微生物測試合格不代表沒問題」——你能解釋微生物測試有哪些「固有限制 (known limitations)」嗎？
blocks.en: Passing microbial test results do not mean there is no problem. Can you explain the "known limitations" of microbial testing?

blocks.zh: 如何建立公用系統的趨勢監控機制，以便在問題發展到 action level 之前及時發現？
blocks.en: How would you set up a trend monitoring mechanism for utilities so that problems are caught before they reach the action level?

blocks.zh: 5.6 Water and Steam 5.6 水與蒸汽
blocks.en: 5.6 Water and Steam

blocks.zh: Water Systems (水系統)：水是藥品製造中最重要的原料之一。製藥用水的等級包括純化水 (Purified Water, PW) 和注射用水 (Water for Injection, WFI)，其微生物和內毒素控制直接影響產品品質。
blocks.en: Water Systems: Water is one of the most important raw materials in pharmaceutical manufacturing. Pharmaceutical water grades include Purified Water (PW) and Water for Injection (WFI), and their microbial and endotoxin control directly affects product quality.

blocks.zh: Microbial Biofilm (微生物生物膜)：微生物在水系統管壁上形成的薄膜狀群落。生物膜一旦建立就極難完全去除，會持續釋放微生物到水流中，導致間歇性的微生物偵測結果。TR90 特別強調新系統應被視為「inherently risky（本質上有風險的）」。
blocks.en: Microbial Biofilm: A film-like community of microorganisms formed on the walls of a water system. Once established, biofilm is extremely difficult to remove completely and continuously sheds microorganisms into the water, leading to intermittent microbial results. TR90 specifically stresses that a new system should be regarded as "inherently risky".

blocks.zh: Seasonal Variation (季節性變化)：水系統的微生物品質會隨季節變化（溫度、原水品質變化），因此確效 (qualification) 必須涵蓋完整的季節週期。
blocks.en: Seasonal Variation: The microbial quality of a water system changes with the seasons (temperature, variation in source water quality), so qualification must cover a full seasonal cycle.

blocks.zh: Critical Points of Use (關鍵使用點)：直接將水送入製程的出水口，其監測頻率應高於用於清潔或不使用的出水口。
blocks.en: Critical Points of Use: Outlets that deliver water directly into the process. They should be monitored more frequently than outlets used for cleaning or those not in use.

blocks.zh: 把水系統想像成你家的自來水管線：新裝好的水管看起來乾淨，但管壁上可能因為安裝過程中的微小刮痕、殘留的焊接碎屑而成為細菌附著的「溫床」。隨著時間推移，這些細菌會形成一層「水垢般」的生物膜——表面上水質檢測偶爾略高、偶爾正常（sporadic, sub-alert results），但生物膜其實已經在管壁上悄悄生長。等你真正「超標」的時候，問題已經很嚴重了。所以 TR90 才說要把新系統當成「本質上有風險的」來對待。
blocks.en: Think of a water system as the tap water pipework in your home: newly installed pipes look clean, but tiny scratches made during installation and leftover weld debris can become a "breeding ground" where bacteria attach. Over time these bacteria form a "scale-like" layer of biofilm. On the surface, test results are occasionally slightly high and occasionally normal (sporadic, sub-alert results), yet the biofilm is quietly growing on the pipe wall. By the time you actually exceed a limit, the problem is already serious. This is why TR90 says a new system should be treated as "inherently risky".

blocks.zh: 跨部門團隊 (Interdepartmental Team) 的重要性：TR90 明確要求水系統的確效和管理策略應由跨部門團隊制定，且必須包含一位具有監控和污染控制經驗的微生物學家。這不是「工程部門的事」——它是 CCS 的核心議題。
blocks.en: The importance of an interdepartmental team: TR90 explicitly requires that the qualification and management strategy for water systems be developed by an interdepartmental team that must include a microbiologist with experience in monitoring and contamination control. This is not "an engineering department matter"; it is a core CCS issue.

blocks.zh: 即時監控技術的進展：TOC（總有機碳）和 conductivity（導電度）已實現線上即時監控，但微生物和內毒素的即時偵測技術仍在開發中。這些技術一旦成熟，將大幅縮短從「發現問題」到「採取行動」的時間。
blocks.en: Advances in real-time monitoring technology: TOC (total organic carbon) and conductivity can already be monitored online in real time, but real-time detection of microorganisms and endotoxin is still under development. Once these technologies mature, they will greatly shorten the time from "discovering a problem" to "taking action".

blocks.zh: Worst-case Location（最差情境位置）：水系統分配迴路中水流最慢、溫度最低、或最容易形成死角 (dead leg) 的位置——這些是微生物最容易滋生的地方。
blocks.en: Worst-case Location: The position in the water distribution loop where flow is slowest, temperature is lowest, or dead legs are most likely to form. These are the places where microorganisms proliferate most easily.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在新建或擴建 WFI 系統時的關鍵考量：
blocks.en: Key considerations for a CDMO building or expanding a WFI system:

blocks.zh: 確效期間必須覆蓋至少一個完整年度的季節變化
blocks.en: Qualification must cover the seasonal variation of at least one full year

blocks.zh: 即使結果在 alert level 以下，也要進行菌種鑑定 (species identification)——某些特定菌種的出現可能暗示系統設計缺陷
blocks.en: Even for results below the alert level, perform species identification, because the appearance of certain species may point to a system design flaw

blocks.zh: 建立趨勢監控系統，將 sub-alert level 的結果也納入追蹤
blocks.en: Set up a trend monitoring system that also tracks sub-alert level results

blocks.zh: 與供應商合作確認管路材質、焊接品質、坡度設計是否有利於排水和防止死角
blocks.en: Work with suppliers to confirm that the piping material, weld quality and slope design promote drainage and prevent dead legs

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 建議將新水系統視為「inherently risky」？請舉出三個可能的風險來源。
blocks.en: Why does TR90 recommend treating a new water system as "inherently risky"? Give three possible sources of risk.

blocks.zh: 解釋為什麼「sporadic, sub-alert results（零星的、低於警戒值的結果）」可能比一次「action level excursion（超過行動限值）」更令人擔憂。
blocks.en: Explain why "sporadic, sub-alert results" may be more worrying than a single "action level excursion".

blocks.zh: 如果你的 WFI 系統在確效期間的夏季出現了 sub-alert level 的微生物增長趨勢，你會如何處理？
blocks.en: If your WFI system shows a sub-alert level trend of microbial growth during summer in the qualification period, how would you handle it?

blocks.zh: 5.7 Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) 5.7 加熱、通風與空調（HVAC）
blocks.en: 5.7 Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC)

blocks.zh: HVAC System (暖通空調系統)：TR90 將 HVAC 定位為「達成適當環境品質的主要系統 (primary system)」。其四大功能：
blocks.en: HVAC System: TR90 positions HVAC as the "primary system for achieving appropriate environmental quality". It has four main functions:

blocks.zh: 引入預處理空氣：確保送入潔淨室的空氣品質符合要求
blocks.en: Introducing pretreated air: Ensuring that the air supplied to the cleanroom meets requirements

blocks.zh: HEPA 過濾與排氣：透過策略性放置的 HEPA 濾網淨化空氣，並通過回風口排除污染
blocks.en: HEPA filtration and exhaust: Purifying the air through strategically placed HEPA filters and removing contamination through return air grilles

blocks.zh: 建立氣壓梯度 (Air Pressure Cascade)：高潔淨區維持正壓，防止低潔淨區的空氣倒灌
blocks.en: Establishing the air pressure cascade: Higher-grade areas are kept at positive pressure to prevent air from lower-grade areas flowing back in

blocks.zh: 溫濕度控制：抑制微生物生長，同時確保操作人員舒適——人員不舒適會導致行為異常（流汗增加微粒釋放、發抖影響精確操作）
blocks.en: Temperature and humidity control: Suppressing microbial growth while keeping operators comfortable. Discomfort leads to abnormal behavior (sweating increases particle shedding, shivering affects precise operations)

blocks.zh: Barrier Technology (屏障技術)：包括隔離器 (Isolator) 和 RABS 等，在 HVAC 之上提供額外的產品保護層。
blocks.en: Barrier Technology: Including isolators and RABS, which provide an additional layer of product protection on top of HVAC.

blocks.zh: HVAC 就像潔淨室的「呼吸系統」：它不斷吸入經過過濾的新鮮空氣（吸氣），同時排出含有污染物的舊空氣（呼氣）。氣壓梯度就像一扇「無形的門」——空氣永遠從高壓（潔淨）區流向低壓（較髒）區，即使你打開房門，也不會有髒空氣「逆流」進來。如果「呼吸系統」出了問題——例如 HEPA 濾網破損或氣壓失衡——整個潔淨室就像一個「無法正常呼吸」的人，系統性地暴露在污染風險中。
blocks.en: HVAC is the cleanroom's "respiratory system": it continuously draws in filtered fresh air (inhaling) while expelling contaminated old air (exhaling). The pressure cascade acts like an "invisible door": air always flows from the high-pressure (clean) area to the low-pressure (dirtier) area, so even when you open a door, no dirty air flows "backward" into the clean area. If the "respiratory system" fails, for example through a damaged HEPA filter or pressure imbalance, the whole cleanroom is like a person who "cannot breathe properly" and is systematically exposed to contamination risk.

blocks.zh: HVAC 設計需考量實際使用情境：TR90 舉了兩個實例——
blocks.en: HVAC design must consider actual use: TR90 gives two examples:

blocks.zh: 人員流量大的區域需要更多的換氣次數 (air changes)，因為人是主要的微粒和微生物來源
blocks.en: Areas with heavy personnel traffic need more air changes, because people are the main source of particles and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 經常進行蒸汽操作的區域需要主動溫濕度控制和強力排氣系統，否則高溫高濕環境反而會促進微生物生長
blocks.en: Areas where steam operations are frequent need active temperature and humidity control and a strong exhaust system; otherwise a hot, humid environment will actually promote microbial growth

blocks.zh: 這再次印證了 TR90 的整體性思維：HVAC 不能獨立設計，必須與人員動線、物料流、清潔消毒等其他 CCS 元素整合考量。
blocks.en: This again confirms TR90's holistic thinking: HVAC cannot be designed in isolation but must be considered together with other CCS elements such as personnel flow, material flow, and cleaning and disinfection.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 提到操作人員的「sweating, shivering, and distracting discomfort」？這和污染控制有什麼關係？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 mention operators' "sweating, shivering, and distracting discomfort"? How is this related to contamination control?

blocks.zh: 在設計 HVAC 系統時，如何決定每個區域的換氣次數？需要考量哪些因素？
blocks.en: When designing an HVAC system, how do you determine the number of air changes for each area? What factors must be considered?

blocks.zh: 如果 HVAC 系統的氣壓梯度在某個時段意外反轉（例如停電後重啟），你的 CCS 中應該有什麼樣的應變程序？
blocks.en: If the HVAC pressure cascade unexpectedly reverses at some point (for example, on restart after a power outage), what response procedure should your CCS include?

blocks.zh: 5.8 Gases 5.8 氣體
blocks.en: 5.8 Gases

blocks.zh: Compressed Gases (壓縮氣體)：藥品製造中常用的氣體包括氮氣 (N2)、壓縮空氣 (compressed air)、二氧化碳 (CO2) 等。它們用於吹瓶、覆蓋 (blanketing)、推動產品、無菌連接等用途。
blocks.en: Compressed Gases: Gases commonly used in pharmaceutical manufacturing include nitrogen (N2), compressed air and carbon dioxide (CO2). They are used for bottle blowing, blanketing, product transfer, sterile connections and similar purposes.

blocks.zh: Point-of-Use Filtration (使用點過濾)：氣體在進入製程或設備之前，在最接近使用位置的地方進行最終過濾（通常使用 0.2 微米或更細的濾膜）。
blocks.en: Point-of-Use Filtration: Final filtration of the gas at the location closest to where it is used, before it enters the process or equipment (usually with a 0.2 micron or finer filter).

blocks.zh: Moisture (水分)：TR90 特別指出水分是氣體系統的關鍵參數，因為黴菌只需要極少的水分就能生長（比細菌和酵母菌更少）。乾燥的氣體系統如果出現了微量水分，可能意味著系統有洩漏或乾燥器失效。
blocks.en: Moisture: TR90 specifically identifies moisture as a key parameter for gas systems, because molds need very little moisture to grow (less than bacteria and yeasts). If trace moisture appears in a dry gas system, it may indicate a leak or a failed dryer.

blocks.zh: 氣體系統就像你家裡的天然氣管線：你期望打開瓦斯爐時得到的是純淨的天然氣，而不是混著水汽或灰塵的「髒氣體」。如果管線中有水分凝結，不僅會影響燃燒效率，還會腐蝕管線——在藥廠裡，這個「水分」就是微生物滋生的溫床。所以氣體系統的「乾燥度」不只是工程品質問題，更是污染控制問題。
blocks.en: A gas system is like the natural gas pipeline in your home: you expect pure natural gas when you turn on the stove, not "dirty gas" mixed with moisture or dust. If moisture condenses in the line, it not only reduces combustion efficiency but also corrodes the pipe. In a pharmaceutical plant, that moisture becomes a breeding ground for microorganisms. So the "dryness" of a gas system is not just an engineering quality issue but a contamination control issue.

blocks.zh: 氣體品質標準的邏輯：
blocks.en: The logic behind gas quality standards:

blocks.zh: 開放製程使用的氣體：品質應等同或優於該區域的潔淨室空氣品質（例如 Grade A 區域使用的氣體應達 Grade A 空氣品質）。
blocks.en: Gases used in open processes: The quality should be equal to or better than the cleanroom air quality of that area (for example, gas used in a Grade A area should meet Grade A air quality).

blocks.zh: 封閉製程使用的氣體：品質應符合該製程本身的要求——不一定需要達到環境空氣等級，但必須滿足製程需求。
blocks.en: Gases used in closed processes: The quality should meet the requirements of the process itself. It does not necessarily have to reach the ambient air grade, but it must satisfy the process needs.

blocks.zh: 這是一個基於風險的分級管控思維——不是所有氣體都需要達到最高標準，而是根據其「與產品的接觸方式」來決定品質要求。
blocks.en: This is risk-based, graded control: not every gas needs to meet the highest standard, and the quality requirement is set according to "how the gas contacts the product".

blocks.zh: 非關鍵支援氣體也需控制：即使不直接接觸產品，支援氣體如果品質不佳，可能影響其他關鍵系統（例如壓縮空氣驅動的閥門如果含有水分和微粒，可能導致閥門故障或密封失效）。
blocks.en: Noncritical support gases also need control: Even if they do not contact the product directly, poor-quality support gases can affect other critical systems (for example, a valve driven by compressed air that contains moisture and particles may malfunction or lose its seal).

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，氣體系統的管理重點：
blocks.en: Key points for managing gas systems in a CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: 建立氣體系統的確效計畫，涵蓋微粒、水分、油分、微生物等參數
blocks.en: Establish a qualification plan for the gas system covering parameters such as particles, moisture, oil and microorganisms

blocks.zh: 制定 point-of-use 濾膜的更換頻率和完整性測試計畫
blocks.en: Define the replacement frequency and integrity testing plan for point-of-use filters

blocks.zh: 特別關注不同產品切換時的氣體管路清潔——避免前一批產品的殘留物透過氣體系統交叉污染
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to cleaning of gas lines at product changeover, to avoid residues from the previous batch cross-contaminating through the gas system

blocks.zh: 將氣體系統的監測數據納入 CCS 的整體趨勢分析
blocks.en: Include gas system monitoring data in the CCS's overall trend analysis

blocks.zh: 為什麼黴菌比細菌和酵母菌對氣體系統的水分更敏感？這對氣體系統的乾燥要求有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why are molds more sensitive than bacteria and yeasts to moisture in gas systems? What does this imply for the dryness requirements of gas systems?

blocks.zh: 如果一個封閉製程使用的氮氣覆蓋 (nitrogen blanketing) 被發現水分含量偏高，可能的根本原因有哪些？你會採取什麼調查步驟？
blocks.en: If the moisture content of nitrogen blanketing used in a closed process is found to be high, what are the possible root causes? What investigation steps would you take?

blocks.zh: EU GMP 和 U.S. GMP 要求壓縮氣體品質「等同或優於」使用區域的潔淨室空氣品質——請解釋這個要求的合理性。
blocks.en: EU GMP and U.S. GMP require compressed gas quality to be "equal to or better than" the cleanroom air quality of the area of use. Explain the rationale for this requirement.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 設計階段就決定 CCS 的基礎：廠房設施的結構性屏障（氣壓梯度、區域分級、物理隔離）是污染控制的第一道防線，必須在設計階段就納入 QRM 考量。
blocks.en: The design stage determines the foundation of the CCS: The structural barriers of the facility (air pressure cascades, area classifications, physical segregation) are the first line of defense against contamination and must be considered with QRM from the design stage.

blocks.zh: 封閉製程是最有效的控制措施：Closed or functionally closed processes 能最有效地隔離產品與環境，減少對人員行為和環境潔淨度的依賴。
blocks.en: Closed processes are the most effective control measure: Closed or functionally closed processes isolate the product from the environment most effectively and reduce reliance on personnel behavior and environmental cleanliness.

blocks.zh: 人是潔淨室的主要污染源：人員流動設計（單向流動、防止不同更衣等級人員混流）是控制人源污染的關鍵。
blocks.en: People are the main source of contamination in the cleanroom: Personnel flow design (unidirectional movement, preventing comingling of personnel in different gowning levels) is the key to controlling human-borne contamination.

blocks.zh: 物料轉移三策略：化學消毒（含物理擦拭）、分層包裝去除、滅菌系統/RTP 直接傳遞——每種方法都需經過確效。
blocks.en: Three material transfer strategies: Chemical disinfection (with physical wiping), shedding of packaging layers, and direct transfer through a sterilization system/RTP. Each method must be validated.

blocks.zh: 公用系統是 CCS 的核心而非獨立設備：水、蒸汽、HVAC、氣體系統直接影響產品品質，需要整體性思維（Holistic Approach）來管理。
blocks.en: Utilities are a core part of the CCS, not standalone equipment: Water, steam, HVAC and gas systems directly affect product quality and must be managed with a holistic approach.

blocks.zh: 物理參數趨勢優先於微生物測試結果：微生物測試有固有限制，TOC、導電度、壓差、水分等物理參數能提供更即時的早期預警。
blocks.en: Physical parameter trends take priority over microbial test results: Microbial testing has inherent limitations, while physical parameters such as TOC, conductivity, differential pressure and moisture give more immediate early warning.

blocks.zh: Sub-alert level 的趨勢也值得關注：不要等到超過 action level 才行動——任何異常趨勢都可能是系統惡化的早期訊號。
blocks.en: Sub-alert level trends also deserve attention: Do not wait until an action level is exceeded before acting; any abnormal trend may be an early sign of system deterioration.

blocks.zh: 新水系統應視為「inherently risky」：生物膜 (biofilm) 可能在確效期間就悄悄發展，需要跨部門團隊持續監控。
blocks.en: A new water system should be regarded as "inherently risky": Biofilm may quietly develop even during qualification, so continuous monitoring by an interdepartmental team is needed.
